model.name: Eliminate MODEL_STORE — ONE store (scenario/index); every unit is a scenario unit
model.description: Tron: 'FULL MIGRATION... AND NO REGRESSION'. data/model-store (server.ts:122, data/model-store/index) is a GENUINELY SEPARATE store holding 784 units (669 exist ONLY there) — ModelElement 661, Folder 86, File 19, Diagram 6, PumlArtifact 6, Project 3, UmlTraceRelationship 3 + a usage-index.json sidecar — with ~67 source refs across writers (TsToModel.generate, model-folder create, diagram add/move/zoom/create, trace author, element hide/remove) and readers (mofChildren, trace-merge M1, isModelUnit routing, usage-index). ELIMINATE it: migrate every unit into scenario/index (the ONE store rooms already use), zero data loss, no regression, and PRESERVE resettability WITHOUT a second store (re-generate becomes idempotent-in-place / replace-by-deterministic-key / never-wipe-a-store). One canonical owner afterwards, zero residual second path. This EXECUTES R40.81's one-physical-store invariant for the model-store case + adds the resettability-preservation mechanism R40.81 did not specify.

discoverySource.measured: data/model-store = 784 total units, 669 exist ONLY there (669 relocate + 115 overlap-with-index), verified by req (measure-not-relay: PO relayed '784 exist only there' = actually 784 TOTAL / 669 only-there). server.ts:122 MODEL_STORE + data/model-store/index + usage-index.json sidecar; ~67 source refs.

Minted as its own req per PO explicit direction; flagged the R40.81 overlap to PO (fold-into-R40.81 vs keep-R40.95 is the PO's call). NOT a blind duplicate.
